```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE)

repo_candidates <- unique(normalizePath(c(
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "..", ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "..", "..", "..")
), mustWork = FALSE))
repo_hit <- vapply(repo_candidates, function(path) {
  desc <- file.path(path, "DESCRIPTION")
  file.exists(desc) && any(grepl("^Package: CellEdgeR$", readLines(desc)))
}, logical(1))
root_dir <- if (any(repo_hit)) repo_candidates[which(repo_hit)[1]] else NA_character_
use_local <- !is.na(root_dir)
```

```{r libs}
if (use_local && requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) {
  devtools::load_all(root_dir)
} else if (!requireNamespace("CellEdgeR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install CellEdgeR or run this report inside the repo with devtools::load_all().")
}

library(CellEdgeR)
library(dplyr)

helpers_path <- if (use_local) {
  file.path(root_dir, "analysis", "hochchulz_2022_melanoma", "hochschulz_2022_melanoma_shared.R")
} else {
  "analysis/hochchulz_2022_melanoma/hochschulz_2022_melanoma_shared.R"

}
source(helpers_path)
```

```{r cache-load}
cache_dir <- if (use_local) file.path(root_dir, "analysis", "cache") else tempdir()
base_cache <- file.path(cache_dir, "hochschulz_base.rds")
if (!file.exists(base_cache)) {
  stop("Base cache not found: ", base_cache, ". Run hochschulz_2022_melanoma_base.Rmd first.")
}

base <- readRDS(base_cache)
graphs <- base$graphs
cells_by_sample <- base$cells_by_sample
edge_cut <- base$edge_cut
sample_df <- base$sample_df
layers_base <- base$layers_base
coef_name <- base$coef_name
group_col <- base$params$group_col
include_wedge <- isTRUE(base$params$include_wedge)
n_cores <- base$params$n_cores
min_cells_per_image <- base$params$min_cells_per_image
seed <- base$params$seed
stab_cache <- file.path(cache_dir, "hochschulz_stability_volume_filter_v3.rds")
force_run <- FALSE
skip_compute <- !force_run && file.exists(stab_cache)

if (skip_compute) {
  stab <- readRDS(stab_cache)
  sample_summary <- stab$sample_summary
  sample_pairs <- stab$sample_pairs
  space_summary <- stab$space_summary
  space_pairs <- stab$space_pairs
  random_summary <- stab$random_summary
  random_pairs <- stab$random_pairs
}
```

```{r params}
set.seed(seed)
sample_keep_fracs <- c(0.8, 0.6)
sample_keep_reps <- 5
spatial_keep_fracs <- c(0.9, 0.7, 0.5)
random_keep_fracs <- c(0.9, 0.7, 0.5)
top_n_stability <- 20
```

```{r sample-downsample}
if (!skip_compute) {
  sample_summary <- data.frame()
  sample_pairs <- data.frame()

  sample_fracs <- sample_keep_fracs[sample_keep_fracs < 1]
  if (length(sample_fracs)) {
    sample_grid <- expand.grid(
      frac = sample_fracs,
      rep = seq_len(sample_keep_reps),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    run_sample <- function(i) {
      frac <- sample_grid$frac[i]
      rep <- sample_grid$rep[i]
      keep <- sample_by_group(sample_df, group_col, frac, seed = seed + rep + round(frac * 100))
      sub_graphs <- subset_graphs_by_sample(graphs, keep)
      sub_counts <- count_motifs_graphs(
        graph_obj = sub_graphs,
        max_edge_len = edge_cut,
        include_wedge = include_wedge,
        n_cores = n_cores,
        verbose = FALSE
      )
      sub_res <- motif_edger(
        cellgraph = sub_counts,
        sample_df = sample_df[keep, , drop = FALSE],
        design_formula = as.formula(paste0("~ ", group_col)),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
      sub_layers <- collect_layer_tables(sub_res, coef_name = coef_name)
      cmp <- compare_layer_sets(layers_base, sub_layers, top_n = top_n_stability)
      out <- list(summary = data.frame(), pairs = data.frame())
      if (nrow(cmp$summary)) {
        cmp$summary$frac <- frac
        cmp$summary$rep <- rep
        cmp$summary$n_samples <- length(keep)
        out$summary <- cmp$summary
      }
      if (rep == 1 && nrow(cmp$pairs)) {
        cmp$pairs$frac <- frac
        cmp$pairs$rep <- rep
        out$pairs <- cmp$pairs
      }
      out
    }
    sample_out <- par_apply(seq_len(nrow(sample_grid)), run_sample, n_cores = n_cores)
    sample_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(sample_out, safe_pull, "summary"))
    sample_pairs <- bind_rows(lapply(sample_out, safe_pull, "pairs"))
  }
}
```

```{r spatial-crop}
if (!skip_compute) {
  space_summary <- data.frame()
  space_pairs <- data.frame()

  space_fracs <- spatial_keep_fracs[spatial_keep_fracs < 1]
  if (length(space_fracs)) {
    run_space <- function(i) {
      keep_frac <- space_fracs[i]
      cells_crop <- crop_cells_by_space(cells_by_sample, keep_frac)
      cells_crop <- filter_cells_by_min(cells_crop, min_cells_per_image)
      if (!length(cells_crop)) return(list(summary = data.frame(), pairs = data.frame()))

      sub_sample_df <- sample_df[names(cells_crop), , drop = FALSE]
      if (length(unique(sub_sample_df[[group_col]])) < 2) {
        message("Skipping keep_frac = ", keep_frac, ": only one group after filtering.")
        return(list(summary = data.frame(), pairs = data.frame()))
      }

      g_crop <- build_cell_graphs(cells_crop, n_cores = n_cores, verbose = FALSE)
      c_crop <- count_motifs_graphs(
        graph_obj = g_crop,
        max_edge_len = edge_cut,
        include_wedge = include_wedge,
        n_cores = n_cores,
        verbose = FALSE
      )
      res_crop <- motif_edger(
        cellgraph = c_crop,
        sample_df = sub_sample_df,
        design_formula = as.formula(paste0("~ ", group_col)),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
      crop_layers <- collect_layer_tables(res_crop, coef_name = coef_name)
      cmp <- compare_layer_sets(layers_base, crop_layers, top_n = top_n_stability)
      out <- list(summary = data.frame(), pairs = data.frame())
      if (nrow(cmp$summary)) {
        cmp$summary$keep_frac <- keep_frac
        cmp$summary$n_samples <- nrow(sub_sample_df)
        out$summary <- cmp$summary
      }
      if (nrow(cmp$pairs)) {
        cmp$pairs$keep_frac <- keep_frac
        out$pairs <- cmp$pairs
      }
      out
    }
    space_out <- par_apply(seq_len(length(space_fracs)), run_space, n_cores = n_cores)
    space_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(space_out, safe_pull, "summary"))
    space_pairs <- bind_rows(lapply(space_out, safe_pull, "pairs"))
  }
}
```

```{r random-cells}
if (!skip_compute) {
  random_summary <- data.frame()
  random_pairs <- data.frame()

  rand_fracs <- random_keep_fracs[random_keep_fracs < 1]
  if (length(rand_fracs)) {
    run_rand <- function(i) {
      keep_frac <- rand_fracs[i]
      cells_rand <- random_subsample_cells(cells_by_sample, keep_frac, seed = seed + round(keep_frac * 1000))
      cells_rand <- filter_cells_by_min(cells_rand, min_cells_per_image)
      if (!length(cells_rand)) return(list(summary = data.frame(), pairs = data.frame()))

      sub_sample_df <- sample_df[names(cells_rand), , drop = FALSE]
      if (length(unique(sub_sample_df[[group_col]])) < 2) {
        message("Skipping keep_frac = ", keep_frac, ": only one group after filtering.")
        return(list(summary = data.frame(), pairs = data.frame()))
      }

      g_rand <- build_cell_graphs(cells_rand, n_cores = n_cores, verbose = FALSE)
      c_rand <- count_motifs_graphs(
        graph_obj = g_rand,
        max_edge_len = edge_cut,
        include_wedge = include_wedge,
        n_cores = n_cores,
        verbose = FALSE
      )
      res_rand <- motif_edger(
        cellgraph = c_rand,
        sample_df = sub_sample_df,
        design_formula = as.formula(paste0("~ ", group_col)),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
      rand_layers <- collect_layer_tables(res_rand, coef_name = coef_name)
      cmp <- compare_layer_sets(layers_base, rand_layers, top_n = top_n_stability)
      out <- list(summary = data.frame(), pairs = data.frame())
      if (nrow(cmp$summary)) {
        cmp$summary$keep_frac <- keep_frac
        cmp$summary$n_samples <- nrow(sub_sample_df)
        out$summary <- cmp$summary
      }
      if (nrow(cmp$pairs)) {
        cmp$pairs$keep_frac <- keep_frac
        out$pairs <- cmp$pairs
      }
      out
    }
    rand_out <- par_apply(seq_len(length(rand_fracs)), run_rand, n_cores = n_cores)
    random_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(rand_out, safe_pull, "summary"))
    random_pairs <- bind_rows(lapply(rand_out, safe_pull, "pairs"))
  }
}
```

```{r cache-save}
if (!skip_compute) {
  saveRDS(
    list(
      sample_summary = sample_summary,
      sample_pairs = sample_pairs,
      space_summary = space_summary,
      space_pairs = space_pairs,
      random_summary = random_summary,
      random_pairs = random_pairs,
      params = list(
        sample_keep_fracs = sample_keep_fracs,
        sample_keep_reps = sample_keep_reps,
        spatial_keep_fracs = spatial_keep_fracs,
        random_keep_fracs = random_keep_fracs,
        top_n_stability = top_n_stability
      )
    ),
    stab_cache
  )
  message("Saved stability cache: ", stab_cache)
} else {
  message("Using existing stability cache: ", stab_cache)
}
```

```{r stability-summary, results='asis'}
format_layer_min <- function(df) {
  if (!nrow(df)) return("none")
  mins <- tapply(df$n, df$layer, function(x) min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  paste(names(mins), unname(mins), sep = ": ", collapse = "; ")
}

cat("Sample downsampling min motif counts per layer: ",
    format_layer_min(sample_summary), ".\n\n", sep = "")
cat("Spatial cropping min motif counts per layer: ",
    format_layer_min(space_summary), ".\n\n", sep = "")
cat("Random cell downsampling min motif counts per layer: ",
    format_layer_min(random_summary), ".\n\n", sep = "")
```
